outreach_draft.subject: A thought on your Personal Injury page
outreach_draft.body:
Hi Ife,

I was looking through Omobitan Law Firm’s site and noticed Immigration, Family Law, and Personal Injury are all presented together on the same Practice Areas page. Those are very different client situations, so a person arriving after an accident currently has to share one general website conversation with immigration and family-law visitors.

A focused Personal Injury page could give that client a clearer path from the first click—what you handle, who you help, what to do next, and why your firm is a fit. It can also give Google a more specific service context and make the site easier for AI systems to understand.

I’d use Personal Injury for the first example because it is a distinct, high-intent journey on the current site.

I’m putting together a quick mockup to show you what I mean. I’ll send it over in the next couple of days.

If you’d rather I didn’t, just let me know.
